name: Coffin Nail of Ash
body:
School transmutation; Level legendary inquisitor 1, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (one wooden stake)

EFFECT

Range touch 22
Target wooden stake touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

When transmuted by the magic of this spell, a wooden stake is a fearsome weapon against the forces of darkness. If you deal at least one hit point of damage with a wooden stake to a helpless corporeal undead, it instantly slays it (this is a full-round action).

It returns to life immediately if the stake is removed or the spell expires, unless the body is disintegrated first.
